card.name: Start of "adverse" before side-effect terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "adverse" (Ad or AD) in headings like adverse reactions or events. Also the word right before "side effects", such as LA after a drug name.

modes.label: Ad/AD in adverse
modes.description: The opening piece of "adverse" in "adverse reactions" or "adverse events" headings and cross-references.
modes.example: To report SUSPECTED<< AD>>VERSE REACTIONS, contact Fresen

modes.label: Before "side effects"
modes.description: A drug name part or adjective that comes right before the words "side effects".
modes.example: Less serious Ritalin<< LA>> side effects include: - Decreased appetite

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing "side" next, as in "side effects".
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into talk of side effects, mostly the start of "adverse reactions".
